definitions.explanation: The coldest season of the year, typically from December to February in Japan.

examples.japanese: {冬|ふゆ}に{雪|ゆき}が{降|ふ}ります。
{冬|ふゆ}は{鍋|なべ}がおいしいです。
examples.english: Hot pot is delicious in winter.

examples.japanese: {今年|ことし}の{冬|ふゆ}は{去年|きょねん}より{寒|さむ}いと{思|おも}います。
examples.english: I think this winter is colder than last year.

examples.japanese: {冬|ふゆ}になると{日|ひ}が{短|みじか}くなって、{五時|ごじ}ごろにはもう{暗|くら}くなります。
examples.english: When winter comes, the days get shorter and it's already dark around five o'clock.

notes:
{冬|ふゆ} is the season of winter, typically from December to February in Japan.

SEASONS IN JAPANESE:
- {春|はる}: spring
- {夏|なつ}: summer
- {秋|あき}: autumn/fall
- {冬|ふゆ}: winter

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {冬休|ふゆやす}み: winter vacation
- {冬至|とうじ}: winter solstice
- {真冬|まふゆ}: midwinter
- {冬服|ふゆふく}: winter clothing
- {冬物|ふゆもの}: winter goods/items

CULTURAL ASSOCIATIONS:
{冬|ふゆ} is associated with {正月|しょうがつ} (New Year), スキー (skiing), {温泉|おんせん} (hot springs), and warm foods like {鍋|なべ} (hot pot).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {冬|ふゆ}になる: winter comes, to become winter
- {冬|ふゆ}に: in winter
